summary: Independent source, ontology, mapping, design, and template checks found no blocking or important issues.

reviewer_context.context: fresh review agent; no producer transcript or prior reviews used

spec_compliance.evidence: 30 columns and 96 uniform data rows; active ms-proteomics, vertebrates, cell-lines v1.1.0 independently derived from template declarations and validated together by parse_sdrf (exit 0). Repeated template and cleavage columns are intentional.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Cellosaurus CVCL_2167 confirms ES-R1, mouse, male, blastocyst donor age and exact hybrid strain. UBERON:0000358 blastocyst occurs during UBERON:0000108 blastula stage; bare label blastula stage is valid for developmental-stage column. Instrument MS:1003028 matches PRIDE. Physical Lys-C MS:1001309 and Asp-N MS:1001304, DDA PRIDE:0000627 and HCD MS:1000422 match records/protocol. No obsolete or wrong-family term found.

source_evidence.evidence: Re-read PXD031548 project record and accession-asserted 98-file list, primary Cellosaurus CVCL_2167 entry, and UBERON term relations. PRIDE protocol supports mouse ES-R1, ML-792 2.5 µM for 48h then 5d recovery, 6 StageTip fractions, paired Standard/Sensitive acquisitions, Exploris 480 DDA/HCD, Lys-C then Asp-N.

file_mapping.evidence: All 96 PRIDE RAW names appear exactly once in 96 SDRF rows, with no extra or missing raw file; all 98 fetched file records assert projectAccessions PXD031548.

design_consistency.evidence: 8 biological preparations: 4 per condition; each has six fractions and two technical acquisitions. Independent filename-to-row comparison found zero mismatches in source, biological replicate, fraction, technical replicate or factor.

omission_safety.evidence: Cellosaurus supports donor blastocyst stage and hybrid strain, without asserting cultured cells remain an embryo. SDRF uses broader blastula stage, avoiding unsupported finer stage. No unsupported per-preparation age/strain differences. Search-only Glu-N is not represented as physical cleavage.
